profile.description: Active Parma community celebration. 2026 ran June 8-13 with parade, car show, park activities, vendors, kids events and rodeo-style activities.

notes.subject: Old contact left committee; current event remains active
notes.body: Julie Blaylock replied in Dec. 2023 that she was no longer on the Old Fort Boise Days committee and instructed Adventure Zone to contact City Hall. Do not use Julie as the current event contact. Current official sources confirm Old Fort Boise Days remained active in Parma in 2026 with a week of community events culminating in a large Saturday celebration. Verify the current city/event coordinator before future outreach.

followUps.label: Find 2027 Old Fort Boise Days coordinator
followUps.reason: The event remains active, but the historical contact left the committee. Identify the current organizer early and evaluate the family-entertainment fit for 2027.
